title: Theo and the Harbor
author: Theo Zhou
blurb: Rafael Marchetti, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
